lead: Sourav Ganguly is an Indian cricketer, born on 8 July 1972 in Kolkata.
As of 2026, he is 54 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and India national cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Banga Bibhushan.
This profile collects the Sourav facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Sourav Ganguly — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sourav Ganguly was born on 8 July 1972 in Kolkata, and holds Indian nationality.
He is a sibling of Snehasish Ganguly.
He received his education at University of Calcutta, St. Xavier's College, Kolkata and St. Xavier's Collegiate School.
He is recorded as speaking Bangla, English and Hindustani.

sections.heading: Sourav Ganguly — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists cricketer, sports executive and athlete as his occupations.

On the team sheet, Sourav has been associated with Kolkata Knight Riders (from 2008 to 2011), India national cricket team (from 1996 to 2008), Bengal cricket team (from 1990 to 2010), Lancashire County Cricket Club (from 2000 to 2000), Glamorgan County Cricket Club (from 2005 to 2005), Northamptonshire County Cricket Club (from 2006 to 2006), Pune Warriors India (from 2011 to 2012) and India Under-19 cricket team. He plays as a batting.
